name: ProgressBar
description: Visualizes progress toward a maximum value.

examples.title: Basic progress
examples.description: Show progress with or without a title.
examples.markup:
<noora-progress-bar value="75" max="100"></noora-progress-bar>
<noora-progress-bar value="150" max="200" title="Storage Used:"></noora-progress-bar>
examples.previewMarkup:
<noora-progress-bar value="75" max="100" style="width: 75%"></noora-progress-bar>
<noora-progress-bar value="150" max="200" title="Storage Used:" style="width: 75%"></noora-progress-bar>

examples.title: Progress levels
examples.description: Compare empty, quarter, half, three-quarter, and complete states.
examples.markup:
<noora-progress-bar value="0" max="100" title="Not started"></noora-progress-bar>
<noora-progress-bar value="25" max="100" title="25% Complete"></noora-progress-bar>
<noora-progress-bar value="50" max="100" title="Halfway there"></noora-progress-bar>
<noora-progress-bar value="75" max="100" title="Almost done"></noora-progress-bar>
<noora-progress-bar value="100" max="100" title="Complete!"></noora-progress-bar>
examples.previewMarkup:
<noora-progress-bar value="0" max="100" title="Not started" style="width: 75%"></noora-progress-bar>
<noora-progress-bar value="25" max="100" title="25% Complete" style="width: 75%"></noora-progress-bar>
<noora-progress-bar value="50" max="100" title="Halfway there" style="width: 75%"></noora-progress-bar>
<noora-progress-bar value="75" max="100" title="Almost done" style="width: 75%"></noora-progress-bar>
<noora-progress-bar value="100" max="100" title="Complete!" style="width: 75%"></noora-progress-bar>

examples.title: Different scales
examples.description: Use any numeric range that suits the measured quantity.
examples.markup:
<noora-progress-bar value="3" max="5" title="Steps completed:"></noora-progress-bar>
<noora-progress-bar value="750" max="1000" title="Points earned:"></noora-progress-bar>
<noora-progress-bar value="847" max="1024" title="Download progress (MB):"></noora-progress-bar>
examples.previewMarkup:
<noora-progress-bar value="3" max="5" title="Steps completed:" style="width: 75%"></noora-progress-bar>
<noora-progress-bar value="750" max="1000" title="Points earned:" style="width: 75%"></noora-progress-bar>
<noora-progress-bar value="847" max="1024" title="Download progress (MB):" style="width: 75%"></noora-progress-bar>

examples.title: Edge cases
examples.description: Show overflowing, very small, and long-title progress values.
examples.markup:
<noora-progress-bar value="120" max="100" title="Exceeded goal:"></noora-progress-bar>
<noora-progress-bar value="1" max="1000" title="Just started:"></noora-progress-bar>
<noora-progress-bar value="42" max="100" title="Very Long Progress Bar Title That Might Wrap:"></noora-progress-bar>
examples.previewMarkup:
<noora-progress-bar value="120" max="100" title="Exceeded goal:" style="width: 75%"></noora-progress-bar>
<noora-progress-bar value="1" max="1000" title="Just started:" style="width: 75%"></noora-progress-bar>
<noora-progress-bar value="42" max="100" title="Very Long Progress Bar Title That Might Wrap:" style="width: 75%"></noora-progress-bar>
